title: Holden RBAC Role
description: Roles are scoped to (segment, device_class), not flat admin/user. The Policy Engine loads these at broker startup; any role granting an action present in the global deny list (broker/config/global-deny-list.yaml) fails config validation at load time rather than at runtime.

segments.description: Explicit list, no wildcards in v1 -- a role covering multiple segments must list each one, so a config diff always shows the exact blast radius change.

allowed_actions.description: Must be a subset of broker/config/action-catalog.yaml entries, and must not intersect the global deny list.

max_tier.description: Ceiling this role can request. Tier 4 (emergency rollback) is not grantable per-role in v1 -- it's a system-level authority, auto-triggered on failed post-change verification or invoked via out-of-band human override, independent of the requesting role.

approval.description: Required whenever allowed_actions includes any tier-3 action. Omitted entirely for roles capped at max_tier <= 2.

approver_roles.description: Human roles (not agent roles) permitted to approve. Approver must not be the same identity that triggered the diagnostic session -- enforced by the Human Approval component, not expressible in this schema.

credential_ttl_seconds.description: Overrides the CA's default leaf-cert TTL for tier-3 credentials minted under this role. Kept short and role-scoped rather than global, so a wider-blast-radius role can be forced to a tighter TTL.

max_consecutive_failures.description: Consecutive failed remediations under this role before tier-3 access auto-halts for it.

max_repeated_rejections.description: Times a human can reject the same proposed fix before it's escalated instead of re-proposed.
